title: Slack notification: exact task-bound review, prepare and send once
goal: Distinguish exact Slack drafting, genuine independent human approval, separate requester preparation and one-attempt sending from verified delivery or permission to retry.
prerequisites: Internal source draft only. Installed-version support, current activation/connection and native usability remain separately unverified.
Open Axiom Bot → App actions → Slack notification with a clean saved task. Unsaved/edited task provider-change entries are disabled. Opening does not execute.
Current verified paired desktop session, accepted workspace membership and commercial access are required; API keys do not authorize this route.
permissions: workspace:read is required for reading. connections:manage is required for requesting/preparing/executing; agent:approve is required for independent review. Current server checks decide authority, not role names or visible controls alone.

Requester is the named executor. A genuine different eligible human must personally approve exact workspace/channel/text; neither requester nor executor may self-approve. No agent, article or checkbox makes this decision.

Current active unrevoked requester-consented Slack connection must match connection ID/revision/workspace and include channels:read and chat:write. Channel must be public, unarchived and Axiom a member; no implicit join, invitation or scope expansion.

Current original requester, executor and distinct reviewer sessions/membership/capabilities are rechecked where required. The same executor may prepare under a new authenticated session only if original requester/reviewer sessions remain valid; operation is bound to preparing session.

steps.instruction: Open Slack notification for the clean saved task; inspect task version. Close only closes the workflow panel.
steps.expectedState: Separate from Bot AI Send. The server binds task organization, creator, version and content hash; later edits invalidate eligibility instead of updating the reviewed message.

steps.instruction: Use Load Slack channels; choose Slack channel and More channels if offered. Nonmember channels are disabled and say invite Axiom first.
steps.expectedState: Reads an explicit authorized public-channel page, no provider message. Invitation/setup requires its own authorization; loading/error is not current connection or delivery proof.

steps.instruction: Enter exact Message in Slack message: nonblank, at most4,000 UTF-8 bytes, no unsupported control or isolated surrogate characters.
steps.expectedState: Typing is local. Byte limit differs from Bot instruction character limit; no Enter-to-send shortcut. Busy or unresolved mutation hold disables editing.

steps.instruction: Save for independent review after task-linked history and a valid member channel are available. Inspect workspace/channel/text, task version and expiry.
steps.expectedState: Saves one requested review, not a Slack message. Successful request clears editor. Initial expiry is15minutes; history and preparation do not renew it. Unresolved request retains original channel/text/task/version/request ID.

steps.instruction: Reload notification history after an unconfirmed mutation. In a non-task-specific review view, Task-linked reviews loads linked records.
steps.expectedState: Existing request ID and exact channel/text/task/version resolve an original draft; a missing result stays unresolved. With latest-record truncation, absence from the list is not evidence that no operation exists.

steps.instruction: A separate eligible human personally checks Review exact Slack message after reading the exact workspace/channel/text record, then chooses Approve exact message.
steps.expectedState: Requested version0 becomes approved version1 only after current independent authority checks. Checkbox is bound to ID/version/intent digest and clears on request. Waiting for another eligible member must not be bypassed.

steps.instruction: Requester/executor personally reviews the approved exact record, checks Review exact Slack message, then chooses Prepare approved message.
steps.expectedState: Rechecks approval/expiry/task/connection/channel evidence/credentials/service; creates session-bound prepared version0. Preparation is not dispatch, renewed expiry or reusable authority.

steps.instruction: Review prepared workspace/channel/text, check Confirm approved Slack send, then explicitly choose Send approved message.
steps.expectedState: Requires enabled current write availability and exact workspace/channel/connection revision plus claim/credential/final-send guards. Claims at most one attempt and consumes independent approval; no delivery promise or retry slot.

steps.instruction: Use Cancel unused message for an eligible requested/approved review; Cancel prepared notification cancels an eligible unused operation.
steps.expectedState: Current original authority and expected versions still apply. Does not retract a message, cancel a consumed dispatch, clear uncertainty or create another attempt.

steps.instruction: Recover saved notification on the original dispatching/unknown operation; preserve Outcome unconfirmed. Do not resend this message.
steps.expectedState: Reads durable record and may mark elapsed dispatch lease unknown. No Slack absence query, resubmission, deadline extension, attempt reset or proof of delivery.

steps.instruction: Read sent as matching saved Slack channel/message timestamp acknowledgement only.
steps.expectedState: HTTP success alone is insufficient: fixed transport checks HTTP200, parsed ok=true, exact channel, timestamp and current guards. Saved acknowledgement still does not verify delivery or human reading; deliveryVerified stays false.

steps.instruction: If disabled, connection needs validation or access fails, preserve history and use separately authorized administrator/setup workflows. Workspace changes require reopening the panel.
steps.expectedState: Visible reviews/controls are not current activation. Workspace changes clear local displayed text/review and abort client work; Close/abort is not provider cancellation or proof no message exists.

expectedOutcome: Identify exact task-bound Slack review and separate one-attempt operation while retaining independent human decisions and unresolved outcomes without duplicate sends.
limitations: Customer eligible:false; publication approved:false; editorial/media/runtime/native/release/shipped acceptance:false. Null review fields and empty media; no screenshots/video/current connection/native/browser/provider acceptance.
Proposed IDs are authoring-only, not runtime bindings. No ingestion, retrieval execution, model evaluation, feature, authority, activation or provider action is created.

Historical guide f0312f54 provenance is preserved. This article binds current4f8c94e1 listed source files, whose bytes are unchanged across these snapshots. Finite comparison is not a complete transitive/deployed review; inclusive ranges are in the recovery source receipt.

Review states requested/approved/consumed/cancelled differ from operation states prepared/dispatching/sent/unknown/refused/cancelled. Refused is not a reusable attempt; prepared is not a provider acknowledgement.
Context-bound in-memory recovery holder is not a documented restart-persistent operation locator. Closing/reopening does not authorize repeating unknown execution.
Existing uncovered-Governance/outbound checks remain mandatory; no Governance activation or complete execution coverage is established. Flags/current access/sessions/credentials were not observed.
Scope is public-channel task-linked notifications and direct review/history boundary, not DMs/private channels/files/edits/deletes/scheduling/full Slack search or all setup/revocation controls.
Evaluation is proposed-not-executed prose. Schema/source integrity is not semantic/editorial acceptance or executed retrieval/model/runtime validation.
recovery: After unconfirmed mutation reload original history with original request identity/channel/text/task/version; missing record remains unresolved. Never invent replacement to bypass uncertainty.
Recover saved notification checks same durable operation only; no provider absence query or resend. Truncated/empty list is not evidence no attempt exists.
Changed task/version, expired approval, revoked/session/connection changes do not gain authority from checkbox/history/refresh or account switch; current server checks remain decisive.
Close/abort/workspace change cannot undo provider attempt; even sent Slack acknowledgement does not prove delivery or reading.
